name: proofable-mcp
description: Every AI tool you use knows your work and follows your rules, with a receipt for every action.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI knows your work and follows your rules.
interface.longDescription: One profile carries your context, agents, skills and keys into every AI tool you use. Each tool loads only what is true now, so answers come out right at a fraction of the tokens. Agents work inside the rules you set, use keys they never see, wait for you on irreversible actions, and leave a receipt you can check. Sign in once with your Proofable account.
defaultPrompt: Check what my agents are allowed to do.
Reuse a proof I already have instead of verifying again.
Show my Proofable profile and what it can prove.
